lines.en: My tail stands up like a flagpole.
I walk with my nose to the ground.
My four legs take small quick steps.
I flip leaves over as I go.

lines.zh: 前面的队伍在动，我跟上
lines.en: The line ahead moves; I keep up.
I push through the brush without pausing.

lines.zh: 这个坡我一天要爬几趟
lines.en: I climb this slope several times a day.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头跳到那块
lines.en: I hop from stone to stone.
My claws turn the soil over.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘得高高的，方便看路
lines.en: Tail high, the better to see ahead.
A rustle follows me the whole way.
I go around a fallen tree.
I push my nose into a hollow.
I sit and scratch my ear.
I perch in the tree, quite at ease.

lines.zh: 下面的路我看得很清楚
lines.en: I can see the path below clearly.
I hook my tail over a branch.
Someone walks under the tree.
I lift my nose and sniff.
An old scar on the bark.
I am counting the sounds below.
I do not call; calling draws attention.
One tail swing keeps my balance.
From here I can see far.
I chew a leaf.
I wipe my face with a forepaw.
I look down at you from the tree.
You looked up. Good.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比我的身体显眼
lines.en: My tail shows more than my body.
Your pocket is bulging.
I tilt my head and measure your height.
You are standing under my tree.
My nose twitches.
In my trade, quick eyes and quick hands.
My hands are very nimble.
I slide down the trunk slowly.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，只是不想被摸
lines.en: I do not fear people; I just dislike being touched.
Your shoelace is loose.
I turn sideways for a better look.

lines.zh: 我在想你的口袋能不能开
lines.en: I am wondering if that pocket opens.
Your smile is not bad.
I am three branches away from you.
I bolt at once.
I chatter twice.
My tail is pinned.
I get behind the trunk.
That rattled me.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着窜上最近的树。
lines.en: Screaming, I bolt up the nearest tree.
My paw stings a little.
I can still climb.
I do not like this.
Do not come closer.
Is that fruit or a bug?
I am coming down; hold still.
You hold it too high.
I can smell it; it is edible.
Let me see your hand first.
Swallowed in one gulp, quickly.
I will remember this taste.
Is there more? More?
I will not snatch, but do not pull back.
Once it is gone, I go.
I bump you and dodge at once.
I slip past your legs.

lines.zh: 你的靴子碰到我的尾巴
lines.en: Your boot touches my tail.
I shrink back, tail first.
I stepped on your instep.
We both step aside.
I kick dust up.

lines.zh: 我慌乱中爬上了你的肩
lines.en: In my scramble I climb onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下把我手里的东西撞掉了
lines.en: That knocked the thing out of my paws.

lines.zh: 尾巴竖起来就是打招呼
lines.en: A raised tail is my greeting.
We groom each other.
The tree is safer.

lines.zh: 一窝小的，照顾起来很累
lines.en: A litter is tiring to look after.
I do not compete; I only guard.
My companions keep watch for me.

lines.zh: 我们吃东西的时候会叫
lines.en: We chatter while we eat.
Same tree, a branch each.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑过去碰了碰
lines.en: I touch noses with her.
The daytime forest is warm.
I dig the soil away with my paws.
This could be traded.
I carry it up the tree.
Let me see if it shines.
I bury it again.

lines.zh: 不重，我一只手就拿得动
lines.en: Not heavy; one paw is enough.
It fell into the hollow.

lines.zh: 我先拿走，谁让它放这儿
lines.en: I take it; why leave it here?
Hide it before it is taken.
That thing is shining.
First I look at you, then at it.
I am coming down.
I am no fighter; I am a runner.
Your pocket is very near.
I am only passing through.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经竖起来了
lines.en: My tail is already up.

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽动，闻到你手里的果。
lines.en: My snout twitches; I smell fruit in your hand.
This tree is my way out.
I will not call; a call would ruin it.
You go left; I go right.
My prints are on the ground.
I will only take a little.
Do not turn around.
I have stayed in the branches.
You take a step; I shift a branch.
I know the ground below better than you.
I flatten my tail.
First let me check for companions.
From this angle you cannot catch me.
I crouch and wait for a chance.
One leaf rustle gives it away.

lines.zh: 我沿着树干转到另一边
lines.en: I move around the trunk.
What is in your hand matters most.
I am not greedy; one item.
The closer you come, the farther in I go.
I wait for your hand to drop.

lines.zh: 这个方法我用过很多次
lines.en: I have used this method many times.
What you heard was a bird.
Only two steps left to the ground.
My paws are quick.
That rake caught your hand.
My tail whips once.
This is not fighting; it is taking.
I leap over your shoulder.

lines.zh: 爪子在你护甲上滑开了
lines.en: My claws slide off your armor.
I chatter as I claw.
I did not get a good grip.
I snatch it and run.
You have my tail.
I turn and bite your wrist.
I drop from above.
I land very softly.
I retreat up the tree.
That was to get free.

lines.zh: 尾巴先出洞，我才探出头。
lines.en: My tail leaves the hollow first, then my head.
Morning light comes in slantwise.
This area smells of fruit.
I climb a low branch and look about.
My old trail is on the ground.
I shake my tail.
Companions are calling far off.
The leaves are still wet.
First I sharpen my claws.
The forest is quieter than yesterday.
I am used to climbing these trees.
First I set my tail up.
Nobody under the tree; perfect.
I walk a few steps along the branch.
This hollow is mine.
My claws catch the rough bark.
Fire catches my tail tip.
I fell off the branch.
Water goes up my nose.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从树上震下来
lines.en: The blast shakes me out of the tree.
An arrow grazes my back.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我毛发竖起
lines.en: That force raises my fur.
Hungry enough to chew bark.
Lightning strikes my tree.
No tree here to climb.
